Published Transfer & Charter Prices

Every price below is a fixed, published rate for inbound travellers — airport transfers, intercity transfers and hourly charters across 331 Chinese cities. The price you see is the price you pay.

All prices in CNY · USD reference at 1 USD = 7.1 CNY · Updated 2026-11-07T11:53:55Z

How our pricing works

  • Airport transfers — a fixed package price covering up to 35 km. Overtime is charged per minute and extra distance per kilometre, both published below.
  • Intercity transfers — priced at the same published rate as airport transfers from the departure city.
  • Hourly charters — a package price bundling the stated hours and distance, from 2 h / 35 km up to 10 h / 125 km.
  • Overtime and overage — charged transparently at the per-minute and per-kilometre rate shown for each city and vehicle.
  • Other cities — anywhere without a published table is quoted on request, usually within 2 hours.
